messages.content: 你能提供關於電影《全面啟動》的簡介，然後再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息嗎？

So we should first call the function for Inception with default (no extra_info) to get brief. Then call again for Inception with extra_info true to get director, cast, awards. Then call again for The Dark Knight with extra_info true. That will produce three calls. The user wants the brief first, then extra info for Inception, then extra info for The Dark Knight. So we need to do three calls. Let's do them sequentially.
